title: my rabbit hole has led me… here?
content: i had a semi-lucid dream recently that was unlike my normal dreams. cant really explain it, it just felt odd, and it has stuck in my memory better than my usual dreams. the first thing i remember in the dream is being on a small island with a couple of other people. we built a raft, and eventually washed up on some unknown metropolis (after some quite choppy seas). we were led into this giant mall and given towels and blankets and food. the mall also had sleeping pods, like what youd find in low-cost hostels in asia. we were offered constant distractions, including a 24/7 arcade that i remember pretty vividly. the vibe reminded me of the lotus eaters from greek mythology, like we were being enticed to stay in the mall forever. there was no exit once we were inside. just distractions and sleep pods. it was a very ominous feeling dream. as the dream went on, it started to get more and more lucid. i started to become more and more aware that something was odd. so i asked the woman at the check in-desk for the sleep-pods, “where do i check out? we’re ready to leave”. she looked right at me and said “there is no leaving”. thats when i woke up.
